analogy.rationale: Antipruritic drugs act mainly on itch-signaling receptors (histamine, neuropeptide, opioid) that are poorly expressed in these cancer cell lines, so they should produce little or no transcriptional response; the closest analogs are other receptor antagonists with similarly limited expression in these cells.
